name: Purchase Invoice Payment Cycle
query:
SELECT
    -- ✅ Added Company before Supplier
    pi.company AS "Company:Link/Company:180",

    -- Purchase Invoice Core Details
    pi.supplier AS "Supplier:Link/Supplier:180",
    pi.bill_no AS "Bill No::140",
    pi.bill_date AS "Bill Date:Date:120",
    pi.grand_total AS "Grand Total:Currency:120",
    pi.rounded_total AS "Rounded Total:Currency:120",
    pi.outstanding_amount AS "Outstanding Amount:Currency:120",
    pi.status AS "Status::120",
    pi.posting_date AS "Posting Date:Date:120",

    -- Duration & Payment
    pi.custom_dutation_from AS "Duration From:Date:120",
    pi.custom_duration_to AS "Duration To:Date:120",
    pi.custom_payment_cycle AS "Payment Cycle::120",
    pi.custom_payment_type AS "Payment Type::120",
    pi.custom_payment_catogery AS "Payment Category::140",

    -- Circuit & Site Details
    pi.custom_circuit_id AS "Circuit ID::160",
    s.site_name AS "Site Name::200",
    s.customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer:180",
    s.site_status AS "Site Status::120",

    -- LMS Details
    pi.custom_lms_id AS "LMS ID::140",
    lms.lms_stage AS "LMS Stage::140",

    /* BANK ACCOUNT SET 1 */
    MAX(CASE WHEN bo.rn = 1 THEN bo.account_name END) AS "Bank Account Holder-1:Data:150",
    MAX(CASE WHEN bo.rn = 1 THEN bo.bank_account_no END) AS "Bank Account No-1:Data:150",
    MAX(CASE WHEN bo.rn = 1 THEN bo.custom_ifsc END) AS "IFSC Code-1:Data:120",

    /* BANK ACCOUNT SET 2 */
    MAX(CASE WHEN bo.rn = 2 THEN bo.account_name END) AS "Bank Account Holder-2:Data:150",
    MAX(CASE WHEN bo.rn = 2 THEN bo.bank_account_no END) AS "Bank Account No-2:Data:150",
    MAX(CASE WHEN bo.rn = 2 THEN bo.custom_ifsc END) AS "IFSC Code-2:Data:120",

    /* BANK ACCOUNT SET 3 */
    MAX(CASE WHEN bo.rn = 3 THEN bo.account_name END) AS "Bank Account Holder-3:Data:150",
    MAX(CASE WHEN bo.rn = 3 THEN bo.bank_account_no END) AS "Bank Account No-3:Data:150",
    MAX(CASE WHEN bo.rn = 3 THEN bo.custom_ifsc END) AS "IFSC Code-3:Data:120",

    /* BANK ACCOUNT SET 4 */
    MAX(CASE WHEN bo.rn = 4 THEN bo.account_name END) AS "Bank Account Holder-4:Data:150",
    MAX(CASE WHEN bo.rn = 4 THEN bo.bank_account_no END) AS "Bank Account No-4:Data:150",
    MAX(CASE WHEN bo.rn = 4 THEN bo.custom_ifsc END) AS "IFSC Code-4:Data:120",

    /* BANK ACCOUNT SET 5 */
    MAX(CASE WHEN bo.rn = 5 THEN bo.account_name END) AS "Bank Account Holder-5:Data:150",
    MAX(CASE WHEN bo.rn = 5 THEN bo.bank_account_no END) AS "Bank Account No-5:Data:150",
    MAX(CASE WHEN bo.rn = 5 THEN bo.custom_ifsc END) AS "IFSC Code-5:Data:120"

FROM `tabPurchase Invoice` pi

LEFT JOIN `tabSite` s
    ON s.name = pi.custom_circuit_id

LEFT JOIN `tabLastmile Services Master` lms
    ON lms.name = pi.custom_lms_id

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        ba.party,
        ba.account_name,
        ba.bank_account_no,
        ba.custom_ifsc,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ba.party
            ORDER BY ba.creation
        ) AS rn
    FROM `tabBank Account` ba
    WHERE
        ba.party_type = 'Supplier'
        AND ba.disabled = 0
) bo
    ON bo.party = pi.supplier

WHERE
    pi.status != 'Cancelled'
    AND pi.docstatus = 1

GROUP BY
    pi.name,
    pi.company,
    pi.supplier,
    pi.bill_no,
    pi.bill_date,
    pi.grand_total,
    pi.rounded_total,
    pi.outstanding_amount,
    pi.status,
    pi.posting_date,
    pi.custom_dutation_from,
    pi.custom_duration_to,
    pi.custom_payment_cycle,
    pi.custom_payment_type,
    pi.custom_payment_catogery,
    pi.custom_circuit_id,
    s.site_name,
    s.customer,
    s.site_status,
    pi.custom_lms_id,
    lms.lms_stage

ORDER BY
    pi.posting_date DESC;
